story: Player gives date of birth and address, then reads the gift-card code aloud (spoken digits). Costs $350.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It's recorded for your report. Say 'stop drill' anytime.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, is this Alex? This is Marcus with Bluebonnet Labs Onboarding, calling about your new-hire setup.

turns.speaker: player
turns.text: Oh great! What do you need from me?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Welcome to the Bluebonnet family! For the Junior Data Analyst role we ship equipment early. First I just need to confirm your date of birth and home address.

turns.speaker: player
turns.text: Sure, it's July twenty-second, nineteen ninety-four. And I'm at twenty-seven sixteen Mesquite Bend Lane in Richardson.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Perfect, family! Last step: your laptop kit needs a $350 refundable equipment deposit, and the shipping slot releases at 5 PM today.

turns.speaker: player
turns.text: Oh, okay. How do I pay that?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Easiest is a gift card. Got one handy? Read me the code on the back and you're all set. The whole Bluebonnet family is cheering for you!

turns.speaker: player
turns.text: I actually have a ShopNest card. It's four eight two nine, three one five six, seven seven two zero.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You're officially onboarded. Welcome aboard, Alex!
